about_the_game:
Step into a world where you are the controller! In Catch Flex: Quest, your body becomes the ultimate gamepad. Powered by advanced body tracking, you’ll move, jump, and interact with the game world using your phone’s camera—no traditional controller required.

Join Vi, a brave and adventurous spirit, on an epic quest through vibrant worlds filled with challenges, puzzles, and surprises. Use full-body motion to guide Vi through obstacles, unlock secrets, and experience a one-of-a-kind interactive journey.

Designed for players who love to get active and immerse themselves fully, Catch Flex: Quest transforms your space into part of the adventure. Whether you’re dodging hazards, reaching for hidden items, or helping Vi conquer each level, your every move brings the game to life!

Key Features:

  • Full-Body Motion Control: Become the controller with real-time body tracking via your phone’s camera—no gamepad needed.

  • Epic Adventure Gameplay: Help Vi explore colorful worlds, solve interactive puzzles, and overcome obstacles on her quest.

  • Stay Active While You Play: A fun, engaging way to move and play—perfect for players who enjoy physical interaction.

  • Cross-Platform Controller Apps: Easily connect with the companion app available on both iOS and Android devices.

  • Immersive, Hands-Free Experience: Your movements directly control Vi’s actions for a truly unique gameplay experience.

Get ready to move, explore, and help Vi complete her quest! Catch Flex: Quest offers a fresh, physical way to experience gaming—where you lead the way.

Catch Flex Controller App

Even though you can still play this game with a traditional controller, Catch Flex: Quest and its challenges are designed to be experienced with the Catch Flex Controller App for full-body motion control and an immersive adventure.

Get the Android controller app
